name: save-button
title: Save Button
description: A bookmark button for a content card. Saving turns it dark and drops a strip naming the collection; from there you can move the item or create a new collection.
use: A card or article can be saved into several named collections and the chosen one should stay visible.
avoid: The panel is absolutely positioned below the button, so an overflow-hidden card will cut it off.
a11y: Focus moves into the picker and back, Escape closes it, and status changes are announced live. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A white card holds a mountain photo above a title and location, with a small rounded Save pill on the right. Saved, the pill darkens; beneath it a narrow white strip and then a taller picker panel list collections with coloured squares and counts.
behaves: Clicking Save fills the bookmark, flips the label to Saved and reveals a strip naming the collection. Change opens a taller list where a click moves the item, and the strip returns showing the new collection before timing out.
customise: Collections, default collection, default saved state and save/move/remove callbacks are props; the swatch palette and strip timeout live in the file.
weight: light: One button and a small panel; motion runs only while the strip opens or swaps.
